name: Call of Earth

angles.text: As a shaman, you prove your resolve before gaining deeper insight into communion with the spirits of stone and soil.
Among the Horde, you encounter shamanistic trials such as Call of Earth as a foundational rite for spiritual practitioners.

faq.answer: Call of Earth asks spiritual initiates to gather requested items and prove their perseverance before advancing in training.
faq.q: What is the Call of Earth?

faq.answer: Finishing the trial shows your grit and determination to your mentor. It proves your focus is strong enough for greater spiritual responsibilities.
faq.q: What does finishing this trial demonstrate?

faq.answer: After Call of Earth, your instructor considers you ready for the next step toward communion with the elements.
faq.q: What happens after completing the Call of Earth?

faq.answer: An initiate proves endurance before communing with earth spirits, whose nature reflects stability and strength.
faq.q: Why must an initiate commune with earth?

faq.answer: A spiritual teacher or shaman mentor guides initiates through the trial and judges their discipline and readiness to bond with the spirits.
faq.q: Who oversees the Call of Earth?

aliases: can anyone do call of earth
is call of earth for shamans
faq.answer: Call of Earth tests those learning to attune themselves to the elements.
faq.q: Who is eligible to undertake this trial?

sections.body: An initiate faces a test of resolve when the instructor asks for particular materials. The gathering tests patience and endurance. By meeting the earth’s demands, the student shows the strength needed to commune with its enduring power.
sections.title: A Test of Resolve

sections.body: When the initiate returns with the requested offerings, the instructor sees their grit. The student has held firm through the trial and is ready for the next step in spiritual training.
sections.title: The Next Step

summary: Initiates gather what their instructor asks of them in Call of Earth. Their effort shows whether they are ready to continue their training.
